# Battery Cell Performance Characterization - Test Dataset B12

## 1. Operating Specifications and Protocol
This experimental report documents the electrochemical cycling, thermal behavior, and
operational parameters for commercial lithium-ion test cells evaluated under laboratory validation protocols.

Notes mention voltage sampling within intervals without identifying start, end or midpoint.
Laboratory notes record inclusive bounds on both sides for the power interval.
Files contain continuous temperature streams without a declared trigger set, so sampling-policy semantics are outside scope.
Completeness of the power records is verified using: completeness_counter, gap_flag_column.

Baseline environmental chamber temperature was maintained at 25.0 C across all test runs.

The data dictionary lists the index recovery method for cycle index as explicit_index_column, filename_encoding.

### 1.1 Detailed Instrumentation and Channel Mapping
Galvanostatic cycling was conducted using an automated multi-channel battery test system.

Channel voltages were calibrated against secondary standards prior to dataset acquisition.

Notes refer to units of the current channel without stating A, mA, V or mV.
Deposit description indicates no scale or offset is applied to the temperature values.

## 2. Archival Summary and End of Report
Validation dataset B12 concluded without hardware interrupt flags.

---
End of Report B12.
